description: This routine is designed to repair and rejuvenate damaged hair, enhancing its strength, shine, and overall health over a period of several months.
frequency: Daily for morning steps; weekly for night and one-day steps
estimated_time: 15-20 minutes per day for daily steps, additional time required on days with deep conditioning treatments

morning_steps.action: Apply a leave-in conditioner or light styling cream.
morning_steps.purpose: To protect and hydrate the hair throughout the day.

night_steps.action: Gently massage a deep conditioning mask into your hair and scalp.
night_steps.purpose: To penetrate and repair the damaged areas of the hair shaft.
recommended_ingredients: Intensive repairing ingredients like biotin, argan oil

weekly_steps.action: Apply a protein treatment for added strength and elasticity.

do: Regularly use heat protectant when styling your hair with heat tools.
Stay hydrated by drinking plenty of water each day to support overall health, including hair.
dont: Avoid using excessive heat or harsh chemical treatments on your hair daily.
common_mistakes: Over-washing can strip natural oils and cause more damage.
Neglecting deep conditioning can lead to further damage over time.

expected_results.2_weeks: Hair feels softer and looks less dry; damaged areas start to show signs of repair.
expected_results.1_month: Visible improvement in hair texture, reduced breakage, increased shine and manageability.
expected_results.3_months: Significant enhancement in overall hair health with improved strength and elasticity.

expert_tips: Regular trims can help prevent split ends from traveling up the hair shaft.
Investing in a wide-tooth comb or detangling brush can reduce breakage during styling.
